paragraphs: Rav Achadvoy said in Rav’s name, Avodah Zarah 34b. [Glosses: Achadvoy. (a) Shabbat 24, end of a: Rav Achadvoy said in Rabbi Mattana’s name should read son of Rav Mattana, as in the new editions. (b) Zevachim 97a: Rav Achavvaya should read Achadvoya; not corrected.]
